# Wishfy

Where ideas meet AI precision.

## Services

- [Content Growth](https://wishfy.ai/services/content-growth/): $4,500/mo — 4 articles/month with strategy, on-page optimisation, and outcomes reporting
- [Content Authority](https://wishfy.ai/services/content-authority/): $8,500/mo — 8 articles + 2 citable assets/month, GEO/AEO layer for AI surface citations
